blocks.text: CRE:100–122 DETAILED REVIEW AND DELEGATED APPROVAL — CANONICAL

The Creation process block was reconsidered from first principles under the standing delegated authority. The review compared five genuinely different architectures per root, scored 45 candidates across 360 criterion values, routed 115 English concepts without forced atomization, passed all 18 canonical packet checks, passed all 24 combined Creation entity/process soundness checks, and passed the complete authority regression. All deterministic generated forms remained unchanged.

Approved architecture: CRE:1xx names substrate-neutral productive transformations. The inward triplet forms or modifies a generative pattern while retaining it within one reference entity; the outward triplet brings one generated artifact into manifestation through productive transformation directed outward from one source; and the systemic triplet coordinates multiple participants in generating one jointly constituted result. The third trit changes only completed, active, or nonactualized phase.

CRE:100 — completed internal pattern formation — Completion of a bounded productive transformation within one reference entity that forms or modifies a generative pattern while retaining it within that entity.

CRE:101 — active internal pattern formation — An ongoing bounded productive transformation within one reference entity that is forming or modifying a generative pattern while retaining it within that entity.

CRE:102 — nonactualized internal pattern formation — A nonactualized bounded productive transformation that would form or modify a generative pattern within one reference entity while retaining it within that entity.
CRE:110 — completed artifact generation — Completion of a bounded productive transformation directed outward from one source that brings one generated artifact into manifestation.
CRE:111 — active artifact generation — An ongoing bounded productive transformation directed outward from one source that is bringing one generated artifact into manifestation.
CRE:112 — nonactualized artifact generation — A nonactualized bounded productive transformation directed outward from one source that would bring one generated artifact into manifestation.

CRE:120 — completed systemic co-generation — Completion of a coordinated productive transformation by multiple participants in one shared production domain that generates one jointly constituted result.
CRE:121 — active systemic co-generation — An ongoing coordinated productive transformation by multiple participants in one shared production domain that is generating one jointly constituted result.

CRE:122 — nonactualized systemic co-generation — A nonactualized coordinated productive transformation by multiple participants in one shared production domain that would generate one jointly constituted result.

Design boundary: these roots do not silently encode the generative entity, mental ideation, represented-data processing, formal algorithm, physical medium or mechanics, structural transition, communication role, restorative goal, quality, value, originality, acceptance, ownership, authorship, publication, scheduling, queueing, probability, or modality. Completion does not entail success under an external criterion. Lexical 1x2 means that the typed productive process is nonactualized; it does not mean planned, ready, scheduled, possible, or future. Runtime [2]/num remains assertion-level uncertainty and never selects lexical nonactualization.
